newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BANKS LIFT SHARE MARKET TO MORE RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: BANKS LIFT SHARE MARKET TO MORE RECORDS.

text.p: Tallinn's bourse maintained its
bullish momentum on Thursday as banking shares boosted it to
new highs.
The Talse index rose 2.61 percent to a fresh record of
322.86. Total turnover was 93.28 million kroons.
Dealers said the market was still responding to a spate of
promising interim results and predicted further gains on
Friday.
Hoiupank surged seven kroons to close at a record 185
kroons. Hansapank's closing price was a record 183.50 kroons
after a gain of 5.50 kroons.
Forekspank also hit a new record level of 205.25 kroons. It
gained 2.75 kroons.
Uhispank was well traded with 29.1 million kroons to gain
slight 0.65 kroons to close at 55.05 kroons.
Dealers said a newspaper report of a new profit forecast
figure for Uhispank sparked the interest of small investors.
"Rumours push prices more than official statements," a
dealer said.
Uhispank denied the proposed profit forecast of 120 million
kroons and said it will announce its official forecast at the
end of August.
On the free market, Norma traded 6.8 million kroons to gain
0.60 kroons to 84.30 kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
